verdict.rationale: Stable's marketing pages list a Shred action that destroys physical mail while keeping digital copies, alongside Ship (forward) and Deposit actions. Together these suggest per-item handling choices for physical mail, but the support is a set of one-line marketing claims with no operational detail. Missing for 10: documented storage windows or retention periods, shred confirmation or certificate, explicit per-item disposal controls (UI or API), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
